claims.text: The resort spans 39 acres along Santa Maria Bay.

findings.quote: Spanning 39 acres along the gentle azure waters of Santa Maria Bay
findings.note: 39 acres on Santa Maria Bay stated

claims.text: The hotel is set on the Golden Corridor, an undeveloped stretch between the hotel zones of Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo.

findings.quote: The hotel is set on the Golden Corridor, an undeveloped stretch between the hotel zones of Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.

claims.text: The landscaping uses native and drought-tolerant plants such as rock figs, agave and saguaro instead of green lawns.

findings.quote: using native and drought-tolerant plants such as beautiful rock figs, all sorts of agave, and tall saguaro, instead of the area’s default unnaturally green lawns

claims.text: Interiors use creamy sandstone, indigenous hardwood, updated equipale chairs, and woven throws and wall hangings.

findings.quote: lots of creamy sandstone and indigenous hardwood, updated equipale chairs, and woven throws and wall hangings

claims.text: The buildings are low-slung and low-density.
Guests who want sea breezes and whale-spotting from their terrace can request a room close to the water.

findings.quote: For sea breezes and optimal whale-spotting from your terrace, request a room close to the water.

claims.text: Marea, the more casual restaurant, has a separate vegan menu.

findings.quote: Marea, the more casual restaurant, has a separate vegan menu

claims.text: Paletas is a marketplace selling handicrafts and gifts, where guests can also grab a cafe con leche and pan dulce.

findings.quote: There's also Paletas, which is more like a marketplace, selling handicrafts and gifts, but where you can also grab a quick café con leche and pan dulce

claims.text: Spa Montage rituals are inspired by the rhythms of the ocean and the local traditions of Baja California Sur.

findings.quote: Inspired by the rhythms of the ocean and local traditions, rituals at Spa Montage are steeped in the beauty and healing power of Baja California Sur.
findings.note: ocean rhythms, local traditions, Baja California Sur

claims.text: Full-day cabana rentals are available at the pool or on the beach.

findings.quote: a full-day luxury cabana rental at the pool or beach

claims.text: The hotel faces the calm Santa Maria Bay, a Cabo beach without big breaking waves where guests can wade right in and swim.

findings.quote: The hotel looks out on the calm, cobalt-blue Santa Maria Bay
it’s one of the rare beaches in Cabo where there aren’t crazy breaking waves and wily currents, where you can just wade right in and go for a swim.
findings.note: no breaking waves, can wade in and swim

claims.text: Montage Los Cabos is the first international hotel from the American-based Montage group.

findings.quote: The hotel is the first international hotel from the American-based Montage group

claims.text: The spa offers guided journeys with the hotel's resident shaman.

findings.quote: the spa has some serious mind-body options, including guided journeys with the hotel's resident shaman

claims.text: Talay serves Thai-inspired street-food dishes from a food truck setup.

findings.quote: Talay adds an unexpected twist with Thai-inspired street-food dishes served from a stylish food truck setup

claims.text: The resort offers complimentary scuba discovery sessions for beginner divers.

findings.quote: Experience the thrill of diving with our complimentary scuba discovery sessions, tailored to beginner divers.
